name: K-Means Spatial Partitioning for Camera Clustering
definition: A data-driven spatial decomposition strategy that uses K-Means clustering on 3D camera center positions to partition large-scale scenes into sub-scenes for parallel training, adapting to the actual distribution of viewpoints rather than using heuristic grids.
summary: K-Means Spatial Partitioning uses K-Means clustering on 3D camera centers to partition scenes for parallel training, differing from Sub-scene Extension by performing only static partitioning without augmenting cluster radii.
